settings.title: Settings
settings.server_config_helper: Editable ntfy settings. Secrets, SMTP sender, upstream and managed authentication settings are hidden and preserved. Duplicate keys, aliases, merge keys and managed options are rejected.
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.invalid_server_config: Invalid YAML: check syntax, duplicate keys, aliases/merge keys and module-managed settings.
settings.ios_push_help: Send wake-up requests through ntfy.sh (or the existing upstream). Message contents stay on this server. An external upstream is required for instant delivery to the official iOS app.

accounts.title: Users and tokens
accounts.description: Manage ntfy accounts, tokens and topic permissions. Configure and start ntfy before using this page. Changes briefly restart ntfy.
accounts.provisioned_help: Existing declaratively provisioned accounts, tokens and rules are preserved. Their protected properties must be changed in the server configuration on the NS8 node.
accounts.no_users: No users yet. Create an administrator first.
accounts.tokens_help: Tokens inherit the user’s permissions. Existing credentials are never returned by the list. New passwords and tokens are shown only in the creation result; copy them before leaving this page. NS8 administrators may also access the task result.
accounts.label: Label
accounts.access_help: Administrators have access to all topics. * represents anonymous clients. Saving an existing topic replaces its rule.
accounts.new_credential: New credential for {username}. Copy it now.
accounts.copy_failed: Copy failed. Show the credential and copy it manually.
accounts.failed: Action failed. Check that ntfy is configured and running, that the account or rule is editable, and inspect the module task log.
accounts.restart_failed: Change saved, but restarting ntfy failed. Save the new credential and inspect the service log.
accounts.invalid_topic: Enter a topic pattern using letters, digits, _, ., - and *.
accounts.confirm_remove: Delete or revoke {name}? This cannot be undone.
